name: Aerodynamic Drag Coefficient from Reynolds Number (Parametric)
description: Drag coefficient C_D has a parametric dependence on Reynolds number Re via the empirical relation C_D = C_D0 + k/Re. Reynolds number varies with speed uncertainty, making C_D uncertain through a parametric UPR.

elements.name: Vehicle Speed
elements.description: Vehicle speed at aerodynamic evaluation point.

uncertainty.source: KaRaceIng GPS speed data across endurance event

elements.name: Maximum Drag Coefficient
elements.description: Lap time simulation: maximum C_D for target endurance lap time

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(v) = F·v + f where F = -k*mu/(rho*L*v²), f = C_D0 + k*mu/(rho*L*v_nom); affine approximation at v_nom=28 m/s
consistency_relations.upr_description: Parametric UPR: C_D is affine function of vehicle speed through empirical Reynolds number relation C_D=C_D0+k/Re.
